attributes.description: Racing New South Wales is the governing body for horse racing in New South Wales, overseeing various functions including race scheduling, licensing, and welfare policies. The organization provides services such as race information, ownership guidance, and support for trainers and participants. Its intended clients include race clubs, trainers, jockeys, and horse owners within the racing industry. Racing NSW also promotes major events like The Everest and The Championships, enhancing the overall experience for racing enthusiasts.
